description: This file defines functions and types for resolving sender names in Feishu, including handling permission errors, caching, and URL correction.

classes.name: FeishuLogger
classes.description: Type for logging function that accepts any number of unknown arguments.

classes.name: FeishuPermissionError
classes.description: Type representing a permission error with code, message, and optional grant URL.

classes.name: SenderNameResult
classes.description: Type representing the result of sender name resolution, including optional name and permission error.

classes.name: FeishuContactUserGetResponse
classes.description: Type representing the response from Feishu contact user get API.

methods.name: correctFeishuScopeInUrl
methods.description: Corrects scope tokens in a URL based on predefined corrections.

methods.name: shouldSuppressPermissionErrorNotice
methods.description: Determines if a permission error message should be suppressed based on ignored tokens.

methods.name: extractPermissionError
methods.description: Extracts a permission error from an unknown error object, parsing response data.

methods.name: resolveSenderLookupIdType
methods.description: Determines the type of sender ID ('open_id', 'user_id', 'union_id') based on its prefix.

methods.name: resolveFeishuSenderName
methods.description: Main function to resolve a sender's name in Feishu, with caching and error handling.
